meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相唱反调,把方案在定稿前反复挑刺打磨。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在重要决策前想先让立场不同的 AI 相互找茬。
copy.tagline_en: Pit multiple AI agents against each other to stress-test a plan before it is finalized.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want opposing AI voices to challenge a critical plan before committing.

howto.what: Claude 会组建一支 5 人对抗规划团队:成员互相挑刺、攻击彼此的结论,只有扛住攻击的洞见被保留,再交给专门的规划者写成正式方案。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉批判式规划,或这项规划需要最高严谨度时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我做这份迁移方案
say.note: 5 名对抗成员开始交叉批判

say.text: 对这份架构设计跑一次对抗式交叉批判
say.note: 互相攻击后只保留站得住的结论

say.text: 用 hyperplan 审一下这个上线计划,越严越好
say.note: 结论交给专门规划者写成正式方案

howto.what_en: Claude forms a 5-member adversarial planning team: members attack each other's findings, only the defensible insights that survive are kept, then a dedicated planner writes the final plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a hyperplan, an adversarial or cross-critique plan, or when the planning needs the most rigor.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan for this migration plan
Run an adversarial cross-critique on this architecture design
say_en.note: Only defensible findings survive the attacks

say_en.text: Hyperplan this launch plan, be as harsh as possible
say_en.note: A dedicated planner then writes the final plan
